strings.subtitle: — Wophwasula mafayilo —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kukoka ndi kutaya sikupezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito batani pansipa.
strings.shred_button: P H W A S U L A
strings.ssd_warning:
Chenjezo! Pa SSD, njira yolemba pamwamba siyitsimikizira kuwononga chifukwa cha TRIM.
Pulogalamu iyi ndi ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayilo "{name}" lidzalembedwa pamwamba ndi kufufutidwa.

Pitirizani?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Iyi ndi shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut yokha ndi yomwe idzawonongedwe.

Fayilo yomwe ikulozayo idzakhala yosweka.

Pitirizani?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Iyi ndi network drive (\\server\share).
Kulemba pa magawo sikutsimikizira kuwononga — seva ikhoza kukhala ndi ma snapshot, deduplication kapena CoW.

Pitirizani?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Iyi ndi removable drive (USB / HDD yakunja).
Woyang'anira akhoza kusunga mabulogu akale mu nkhokwe.

Pitirizani?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS njira zina za data (ADS) sizigwiritsidwa ntchito.
• Buku la USN silitsukidwa.
• Makope a mthunzi ndi kulumikizana kwa mtambo
  (OneDrive ndi zina) sizikhudzidwa.
strings.status_full: Zomwe zili mkati zidalembedwa zonse ndi ziro. Kubwezeretsa sikutheka — zida zidzaona ziro zokha.
strings.status_fast: Mutu, mchira ndi mizere 4 MB idalembedwa pamwamba. Zotsala sizinakhudzidwe, koma chifukwa cha minga, kubwezeretsa kwathunthu ndi zida za ogula sikutheka. Pa zikalata zachinsinsi gwiritsani ntchito njira YATHUNTHU.
strings.status_empty: Fayilo linali lopanda kanthu, kulemba pamwamba sikunali kofunika. Linafufutidwa.
strings.error_permission: Sikungathe kufikira fayilo. Ikhoza kukhala yotsegulidwa mu pulogalamu ina. Tsekani ndipo yesaninso.
strings.error_not_found: Fayilo sinapezeke. Ikhoza kukhala yachotsedwa kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ndi symbolic link. Ma link sangawonongedwe — fayilo yomwe ikulozayo idzakhala yosweka.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ndi fayilo ya placeholder (OneDrive kapena zina). Deta yake ili mu mtambo, osati pa disk — palibe chowononga pano.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi si fayilo (foda kapena china). Gweretsani fayilo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayilo iyi ili ndi ma hard link ena ({n} onse). Ma hard link alibe woyamba — mayina onse ndi ofanana. Ngati muwononga kudzera munjira yapano, deta idzalembedwanso ndikudulidwa ku 32 bytes, koma zotsalira zidzakhala zofikirika kudzera ma link ena. Chotsani ma link onse choyamba.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayilo ndi yoponderezedwa, yobisidwa kapena sparse. Kulemba ndi ziro sikutsimikizira kuwononga deta yakale chifukwa NTFS imasunga mosiyana.

Chotsani mawonekedwe: dinani kumanja → Zinthu → Zapamwamba → chotsani chizindikiro cha 'Pondereza' ndi/kapena 'Bisa'. Kenako yambitsaninso SHREDDER.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Mafayilo {count} adzawonongedwa.
Kukula konse: {size}.

Onani mndandanda musanapitirize.
Ntchito iyi siyingasinthidwe.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Chotsani mafayilo onse {count} mu mzere?

Mafayilo enieni SADZAKHUDZIDWA — mndandanda wokha.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fayilo "{name}" ili ndi ma hard link ena ({nlink} onse).

Deta idzawonongedwa pamayina onse.
Koma zotsalira (32 bytes) zidzatsala pansi pa mayina ena mu foda.

Mungafunike kuchotsa zotsalirazi pamanja.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Gwiritsani ntchito pa ma hard link onse mu mzere
